Name: mia's ears - fs (elf - elven - fantasy)
Author: fantasyandmana
Description:
[center][/center][left][b][size=5]requirements:[/size][/b][/left][size=3]correctly installed copies of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]fashion sense[/url][/size][left]
[b][size=5]description:[/size][/b]
[size=3]this mod adds 9 pairs of whimsical ears to the fashion sense menu, under the 'accessories' tab.[/size][/left][size=3]
no animations are included. modded skin tones work innately. [b]note that if you are not using a custom fashion sense body overlay, your h/s/b ratio must be (any)/0/100.[/b]

every ear is included in the showcase images.[/size]

[b][size=5]compatibility:[/size][/b]
[size=3][size=3]the assets were drawn with the vanilla farmer's head position in mind, so [/size][size=3][size=3]there's no guarantee[/size][/size] that resprites will work correctly. seasonalcute has been tested and looks fine.

suggestions & patch requests are always welcome!

[size=3][i]to-do: better interaction with hairs[/i][/size]

[/size][size=5][b]recommendations:[/b][/size]
[size=3]peacefulend's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23740]player height variety for fs[/url][/size]
[size=3]goblinhours' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7732]expressive elf ears[/url][/size]
